habit_scope: Slab-on-grade strip: no basement hole. Remove debris/stumps/organics; compact granular fill; set finish floor high enough for drainage. CMHC Ch7 Slabs-on-ground (Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC); ORNL Ch 4 / HUD §4.1 slab as South/SW habit (Fontana). Alt to the full basement hole. Depth still follows the P05 slab type on the drawings.
how_it_is_done: HUD §4.1: a slab-on-grade with independent stem wall or a monolithic/thickened-edge slab is normally used in warmer regions with little or no frost depth (also used in colder climates when adequate frost protection is provided). Fontana / South habit. Not the Wasatch basement hole.

CMHC Ch7 Slabs-on-ground: 'Remove all debris, stumps and organic matter from the area below the slab and fill voids with compacted granular material to provide a smooth surface free of soft pockets.' 'The top of the slab must be at least 150 mm (6 in.) above finished grade' so finished grade drains away. Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC. ORNL Ch 4 elevate slab ≥8 in above grade is the US P05 slab note — do not pick a winner; confirm AHJ.
ORNL: compact fill under slab (FLOOR SLAB checklist). AF&PA: compact fill / stripped-root areas before pour.
No foundation drain as habit if the floor is above grade (ORNL Ch 4 / P05 slab). Site drainage still slopes away. Do not shop drain tile onto a Fontana valley slab as habit.
Still: utility locate (P01), no frozen subgrade if any frost-depth stem is used, footing/thickened-edge inspect before pour (ORNL).
trades: ORNL grading contractor — no crew size
tools_equipment: Compaction of granular fill (CMHC/ORNL). No SKU.
inspection_hold_points: Organics out; compacted granular; no soft pockets (CMHC). Compact fill under slab (ORNL). Footing / thickened-edge layout before pour.
when_this_beats_habit: South / Southwest / Fontana slab habit (HUD §4.1). Not the Wasatch basement hole.
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: Forcing a SOG strip on a 30-in frost basement lot as if it were Fontana. Leaving organics under the slab.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: Valley slab crews already strip and compact. What they skip is organics out and poly/termite before the pour (P06).
permit_gate: should be on drawings before permit
permit_gate_notes: Slab vs basement on the drawings. Confirm with AHJ / engineer.
risk_if_swapped_late: Slab vs basement after permit is a type change: no joists, no basement stairs, different excavation.
plain_language_summary: Fontana does not buy a basement hole. Strip the organics, compact the granular, set the slab high enough that water runs away. Drain tile is not the valley habit. 6 in (CMHC) vs 8 in (ORNL) above grade — confirm the AHJ; do not pick a winner.
spanish_summary: Fontana no compra hueco de sótano. Quite orgánicos, compacte el granular, deje la losa alta para que el agua corra. El drain tile no es el hábito del valle. 6 pulg (CMHC) vs 8 pulg (ORNL) — confirme el AHJ.
locators: CMHC Ch7 Slabs-on-ground (printed p 82): debris/stumps/organics out; compacted granular; slab ≥150 mm (6 in) above finished grade
HUD RSDG §4.1 slab-on-grade in warmer regions; ORNL Ch 4 compact fill under slab / ≥8 in above grade
confidence_notes: SOG strip sequence sourced. 6 in vs 8 in both printed — do not pick a winner. Drain tile not this Method.
remodel_note: Remodel extras (matching, occupied-site, shoring, demo of an existing house) are not a sequence in CMHC/ORNL/HUD/FM — Gap, do not invent remodel-only methods. Essential Guide is framing-only (opened 2026-08-30; silent on site/layout). B&D Room Additions not used as a P00–P06 sequence.
layering: Strip organics → compacted granular → (P06 poly/termite/radon/plumbing) → slab pour. Canadian 6 in above grade vs ORNL ≥8 in — both sourced; confirm AHJ; do not pick a winner.
code_to_check: CMHC 6 in above grade is Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC. ORNL ≥8 in is US handbook. Confirm with AHJ / engineer. Do not invent R506.

inspector_looks_for: Debris, stumps, organics gone under the slab (CMHC). Compacted granular, no soft pockets. Finish floor high enough that grade drains away.
do_not_cheap: Do not leave organics under the slab (CMHC). Compact the granular (ORNL/CMHC). Do not shop P05 drain tile onto an above-grade SOG as habit.
smart_save: No basement hole on a Fontana/South SOG. No drain tile if the floor is above grade (ORNL Ch 4). No dollars. Late swap vs basement is a type change.
